caseNameFull: Alabama v. King & Boozer, a Partnership and Curry, Commissioner of Revenue v. United States
attorneys: Messrs. Thomas S. Lawson, Attorney General of Alabama, John W. Lapsley, and J. Edward Thornton, Assistant Attorneys General, for petitioners. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy and Mr. Fred L. Blackmon for respondents.

opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Alabama granted.

Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of these applications.

Reported below: 241 Ala. 557, 569; 3 So. 2d 572, 582.
